responsibility: Headless public-SDK consumer that proves deterministic manual frame pumping, quit safe-boundary semantics, and the production monotonic time port.

lifetime.scope: process-owned App and monotonic time-source consumer
lifetime.creation: main creates the time source and App through public A-Engine SDK factories
lifetime.shutdown: main requests Quit, pumps the safe boundary, then caller-owned time source and App release through RAII before process exit

invariants.text: The headless consumer reaches stopped state after exactly three pumped frames followed by a quit safe-boundary pump.
The headless consumer accesses application lifecycle only through public A-Engine SDK headers.
The headless consumer samples the production monotonic time port through the public SDK and rejects a backwards sample.
